GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Comprehension.

2. When practising Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues.

3. When practising Active listening Public speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Active listening Public speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Active listening Public speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Active listening Public speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active listening Public speaking.

4. When practising Intensive reading Extensive reading Reservations and bookings ● Planning a holid, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive reading Extensive reading Reservations and bookings ● Planning a holid.

   C. Copy random text without understanding Intensive reading Extensive reading Reservations and bookings ● Planning a holid.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Intensive reading Extensive reading Reservations and bookings ● Planning a holid.

5. When practising Extensive reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Extensive reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Extensive reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Extensive reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Extensive reading.

6. When practising Listening for Information Public speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information Public speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information Public speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information Public speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information Public speaking.

7. When practising Reading for details, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading for details.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading for details.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for details.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for details.

8. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Good day / hello
   B. Good night
   C. Thank you
   D. Please

9. When practising Listening for information Conversational Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for information Conversational Skills.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for information Conversational Skills.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for information Conversational Skills.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for information Conversational Skills.

10. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Buch
   B. Schule
   C. Haus
   D. Wasser

11. When practising Listening for details Presentation skills., which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for details Presentation skills..
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for details Presentation skills..
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for details Presentation skills..
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for details Presentation skills..

12. When practising ● Speed reading ● Evaluative reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding ● Speed reading ● Evaluative reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to ● Speed reading ● Evaluative reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” ● Speed reading ● Evaluative reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for ● Speed reading ● Evaluative reading.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for details and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Extensive reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain ● Speed reading ● Evaluative reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Intensive Reading Extensive Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
